第11章 侦查行动-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安没有急着动。

他坐回床上，把陈亚军的信息从天珠APP里调出来，截了图，存到手机的加密相册里。

然后拿起笔记本，把已知的信息逐条列出来。

陈亚军，男，四十七岁，赣省户籍。鹏城理工大学经济学院副教授。名下两家公司：一家叫“睿诚商务咨询有限公司”，注册在福田CBD；另一家叫“鑫远国际贸易有限公司”，注册地在前海自贸区。

两家公司的注册资本都不大，五百万。但注册地点很讲究。

一个在金融核心区，一个在政策红利区。

做咨询的不需要大资本，做贸易的注册在前海可以享受税收优惠和跨境结算便利。

如果要洗钱，这两个壳子简直是教科书级别的配置。

顾承安在笔记本上画了两个方框，分别写上公司名，用箭头指向中间的“陈亚军”。

但他没有继续往下推演。

信息不够。

凭现有的东西，连上报都不够格。一个系统给出的标签，没有任何实质性证据。国安那边不是街道办，你不能拿一句“我的APP说他是洗钱的”去交差。

得有料。

顾承安看了一眼时间，下午两点多了。

他换上黄马褂，戴好头盔，出门。

目的地：科技园南区。

理由很简单——上午采集到陈亚军信息的那栋写字楼，叫“远洋国际中心”。二十八层，入驻了大量金融、贸易、投资类公司。

陈亚军的“睿诚商务咨询”不在这栋楼里。但他本人上午出现在这里，说明他在这栋楼里大概率有业务往来对象。

顾承安要做的事很简单：再去一趟，用天珠，看看能不能扫到更多关联人物。

骑到科技园南区，他把电动车停在远洋国际中心对面的商业裙楼外。没有直接进写字楼。

先打开外卖软件，接了一个附近的单。取餐点在远洋国际中心一楼的连锁咖啡店。

名正言顺。

咖啡店等了差不多五分钟。出餐慢，顾承安站在取餐台前，环顾四周。

一楼大堂很气派，中央是环形前台，四面通透的落地玻璃，人流不算太大。进出的人大多西装革履，步履匆忙。

电梯口有闸机。

刷卡才能进。

外卖员只能把东西交给前台，由物业转送，核心楼层根本上不去。

这就是问题所在，天珠的扫描半径只有十米。他站在一楼大堂，最多能覆盖到进出电梯的人流，真正在楼上办公的，扫不到。

数了下，五分钟时间天珠采集到三十七条数据。

顾承安拿了咖啡，送完单，骑车回到对面商业裙楼。

找了个奶茶店坐下来，点了杯柠檬水。

开始翻数据。

三十七条，清一色的普通人。白领、前台、保安、快递员。

没有收获。

意料之中。

Gu Chengan didn't move in a hurry.

He sat back on the bed, pulled up Chen Yajun's information from the Tianzhu APP, took a screenshot, and saved it in the encrypted photo album of his phone.

Then pick up your notebook and list the known information item by item.

Chen Yajun, male, 47 years old, registered in Gan Province.Associate professor at the School of Economics, Pengcheng University of Technology.There are two companies under his name: one is called "Ruicheng Business Consulting Co., Ltd." and is registered in Futian CBD; the other is called "Xinyuan International Trade Co., Ltd." and is registered in the Qianhai Free Trade Zone.

The registered capital of both companies is not large, only 5 million.But the registration location is very particular.

One is in the financial core area and the other is in the policy dividend area.

Those who do consulting do not need large capital, and those who do business can enjoy tax benefits and cross-border settlement convenience by registering in Qianhai.

If you want to launder money, these two shells are simply a textbook-level configuration.

Gu Chengan drew two boxes in his notebook, wrote the company name respectively, and pointed an arrow to "Chen Yajun" in the middle.

But he did not proceed further.

Not enough information.

With what we have now, we are not even qualified to submit a report.A label given by a system without any substantive evidence.The National Security Bureau is not the sub-district office, so you can’t report it by saying, “My APP says he is a money launderer.”

There has to be material.

Gu Chengan glanced at the time, it was after two o'clock in the afternoon.

He put on his yellow jacket, put on his helmet, and went out.

Destination: South District of Science and Technology Park.

The reason is simple - the office building where Chen Yajun's information was collected in the morning is called "Ocean International Center".On the twenty-eighth floor, a large number of financial, trading, and investment companies have settled.

Chen Yajun's "Ruicheng Business Consulting" is not in this building.But the fact that he appeared here in the morning indicates that he most likely has business contacts in this building.

What Gu Chengan has to do is simple: go there again, use the Dzi Beads, and see if he can scan more related people.

Riding to the south area of ​​the Science and Technology Park, he parked his electric bike outside the commercial podium opposite the Ocean International Center.Did not enter the office building directly.

First, I opened the takeout app and took an order from a nearby place.Pick up meals at the chain coffee shop on the first floor of Ocean International Center.

Justified.

The wait at the coffee shop was almost five minutes.The meal was served slowly. Gu Chengan stood in front of the dining table and looked around.

The lobby on the first floor is very grand, with a circular front desk in the center and transparent floor-to-ceiling glass on all sides, so the flow of people is not too large.Most of the people coming in and out were in suits and leather shoes, walking in a hurry.

There is a turnstile at the elevator entrance.

You have to swipe your card to enter.

The delivery person can only hand the items to the front desk for transfer by the property management, and cannot go up to the core floor at all.

This is the problem, the scanning radius of Dzi beads is only ten meters.Standing in the lobby on the first floor, he could at most cover the flow of people entering and exiting the elevator. He could not catch the people actually working upstairs.

After counting, Dzi Bead collected thirty-seven pieces of data in five minutes.

Gu Chengan took the coffee, delivered the order, and rode back to the commercial podium building opposite.

I found a milk tea shop and sat down and ordered a glass of lemonade.

Start flipping through data.

Thirty-seven, all ordinary people.White-collar workers, front desk, security, courier.

Nothing gained.

As expected.
